name: Nidec Engineering Design System

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Nidec green for static brand surfaces, graphics, selection markers and focus-adjacent accents. Reaches 3.63:1 on surface, so never use it for text or as a fill behind white text; use brand-strong for that.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Primary action fill with on-brand text, and brand-coloured text and links on surface or canvas (5.12:1 on surface). Hover, pressed and selected states are derived from it by mixing toward text at 18%, 50% and 35%.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Light green fill for hover and selected rows, options and menu items. Hold text on it to text or text-secondary; brand-strong on brand-soft is 4.42:1 and misses the 4.5:1 floor for small text.

tokens.name: on-brand-strong
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-strong fills (5.12:1). Not a repository role; the shared package uses white here and this token names it.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on surface, canvas, surface-subtle and brand-soft (14.3:1 or better).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text, field labels and secondary content on surface, canvas, surface-subtle and brand-soft (7.9:1 or better).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Hints, captions and placeholders on surface (4.93:1) and canvas (4.58:1) only. It falls below 4.5:1 on surface-subtle (4.41:1) and brand-soft (4.25:1); use text-secondary there. Also the colour for actionable control boundaries.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind white modules.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Module, card, navigation, dialog and popover surfaces. Overlays stay opaque.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Quiet fills such as table headers, disabled areas and neutral selected segments.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers on surface. It is 1.38:1 on white, so it must never be the only cue that a control exists; use text-muted for interactive boundaries.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger decorative separation on surface (1.82:1). Not an interactive boundary.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational text, icons and message accents on surface, canvas and surface-subtle (5.17:1 or better). Pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on surface and canvas (5.19:1 or better). Pair with a word or icon; it is close to the brand green. Which business states count as success belongs to the consuming application.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on surface and canvas (5.27:1 or better). Pair with a word or icon. State meaning belongs to the consuming application.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, destructive emphasis and invalid-field feedback on surface and canvas (6.07:1 or better). Show errors next to the field in words, not by colour alone.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: a white inner ring and a blue outer ring, 5.77:1 on surface. Focus stays blue even though the brand is green.

styles.name: body1
styles.usage: Default body, field values and table text (Fluent fontSizeBase300).

styles.name: subtitle2
styles.usage: Page sub-headings and selected primary identities (Fluent fontSizeBase400). Secondary module headings stay regular weight.

styles.name: title1
styles.usage: Large page and authentication headings (Fluent fontSizeHero800).

tokens.name: space-xxs
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps inside compact controls (Fluent spacing XXS).

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Gap between the two ViewModeToggle buttons and between icon and label (Fluent spacing XS).

tokens.name: space-s
tokens.usage: Gap between adjacent actions and inside toolbars (Fluent spacing S).

tokens.name: space-m
tokens.usage: Gap between the view toggle and the count, sort or filter control before it (Fluent spacing M).

tokens.name: space-l
tokens.usage: Field-to-field gap and standard module padding (Fluent spacing L).

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Gap between form groups (Fluent spacing XL).

tokens.name: space-xxl
tokens.usage: Gap between modules and page sections (Fluent spacing XXL).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small marks and inline chips (Fluent borderRadiusSmall).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and dropdowns (Fluent borderRadiusMedium).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, modules, popovers and menus (Fluent borderRadiusLarge).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: InlineModeTabs capsules and circular indicators (Fluent borderRadiusCircular).

checksNote: Build fails if a pair listed here drops below its minimum contrast ratio. The ratios quoted in the usage notes are written by hand: update them when the palette changes.
